retrievalProfile.description: A stark black-and-white portrait featuring a subject partially obscured by deep shadows or clothing, utilizing extreme contrast and minimalist sans-serif typography positioned at the edges.
triggerTerms: stark black and white album cover
excludeWhen: soft lighting or gradients are needed
centered large-scale display type is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochrome composition where a central figure is defined by sharp shadows and bright highlights, set against a pure white background. The subject's face is partially hidden by a large, dark silhouette (like a collar), and the image features a visible halftone or grain texture. Typography is small, geometric, and pushed to the extreme margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject partially obscured by a large black geometric silhouette
Extreme contrast between pure white background and deep black shadows
Small-scale typography balanced against a large central visual weight
Halftone texture providing mid-tone detail in the face
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern in skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait, medium-close up, with the lower half of the frame dominated by a dark silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, which are the only detailed features visible above the dark mass.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes down to the dark silhouette, then outward to the small text at the top and left margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the head and at the top corners.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; binary value relationship with minimal gray mid-tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Occasional use of a 'no' symbol or slashed circle as a character replacement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying orientation and tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, mid-century geometric aesthetic.
Provides a slightly more industrial, 80s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a person where the bottom half of the face is obscured by a sharp, black silhouette of a high collar. The background must be pure white. Apply a subtle halftone dot texture to the skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, black, geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Place one line horizontally at the top left, one line vertically down the left margin, and a serial number in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the contrast extreme with deep blacks?
Is the text small and pushed to the margins?
Is there a visible halftone texture in the mid-tones?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray gradients in the background
Verify text is legible but unobtrusive
Check that the halftone effect doesn't muddy the eyes
Confirm the silhouette is solid black
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + solid black foreground silhouette + pure white background + edge-aligned geometric sans-serif typography.
